ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure; on the left there is a benzene ring, and the benzene ring is connected to the central iodine I; around iodine are connected the upper OAc, the upper-left AcO, two upper/lower oxygen-related connections, and it is connected to the lower carbonyl-containing fragment. On the right there is also a separate OAc anion, and the figure also has reaction arrows and a labeled H. Reasoning count: According to the problem, ignore arrows and exclude bonds involving hydrogen. First count the 6 C-C bonds inside the benzene ring. Then count the visible heavy-atom skeleton bonds in the non-acetate-label-expanded part: aryl-I, I-O upper, I-O lower, upper O-C*, C*-R1, C*-R2, I-OAc top attachment, I-AcO left attachment, lower O-carbonyl C, carbonyl C=O, carbonyl C-aryl, for a total of 11. Therefore the skeleton/connection bonds are 6 + 11 = 17. There are three acetate component labels in the figure that need to be expanded: left AcO, top OAc, and right independent OAc anion; each acetate contributes O-C, C=O, and C-C, for a total of 3 non-hydrogen bonds, so 3 × 3 = 9. The total is 17 + 9 = 26.

This gives 17 framework/attachment bonds. Then expand the three acetate labels present in the image: left AcO, top OAc, and the separate right OAc anion; each contributes O-C, C=O, and C-C = 3 non-H bonds, so 3×3=9. Exclude the C-H bond shown next to H and disregard arrows. Total = 17+9 = 26.

method.method_draft: Build a unique adjacency list. Start at iodine: count its five heavy-atom bonds to aryl C, upper O, lower O, left AcO O, and top OAc O = 5. Add edges not yet counted from neighboring atoms: upper O-C* = 1, lower O-carbonyl C = 1, C*-R1 and C*-R2 = 2, carbonyl C-aryl and carbonyl C=O = 2. Add the six benzene-ring C-C edges = 6. This visible heavy-atom graph contributes 5+1+1+2+2+6 = 17. Now add hidden internal bonds in the three acetate groups visible as AcO/OAc labels: 3 groups × 3 bonds per acetate = 9. Do not count the C-H edge or any curved arrow. Final count = 17+9 = 26.
